About this shortlist & source checksResearch snapshot · October 20, 2026. Ordered by senior design fit and source confidence, not a definitive employer ranking. Pay is employer-listed where available; geography and compensation basis can differ. “Indexed only” means the live posting could not be fully confirmed. Unpublished team sizes and contacts are left unknown. Director-level roles and verified posting dates before 2024 are omitted. Unknown posting dates remain. Company and team sizes are approximate; size sorting uses the first disclosed number or lower bound, with unknown headcounts last. Entity evidence may identify a parent or historical filer; it does not establish current good standing, active hiring, or the authenticity of an offer. Posted dates come from employer pages or their JobPosting metadata; they may reflect a repost rather than original creation. Date ages and filters use the October 20 research snapshot, not an ongoing refresh. “Not found” means a date was not verified. The clearance filter hides stated clearance or government-access requirements, including preferred clearance; absence of a marker does not confirm eligibility.
